questionText:
Consider the control flow graph given below.

Which one of the following options is the set of live variables at the exit point of each basic block?
options: $B1: \{a, b, c, e, f\}, B2: \{d, e\}, B3: \{b, c, e, f\}, B4: \emptyset$
$B1: \emptyset, B2: \{d, e\}, B3: \{a, c, f\}, B4: \emptyset$
$B1: \{a, b, c, e, f\}, B2: \{d, e\}, B3: \{c, e, f\}, B4: \emptyset$
$B1: \emptyset, B2: \{d, e, f\}, B3: \{a, b, c, e, f\}, B4: \emptyset$
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

Live variable analysis is a backward data-flow analysis. The data-flow equations are defined as:
$$Live_{out}(B) = \bigcup_{S \in succ(B)} Live_{in}(S)$$
$$Live_{in}(B) = use(B) \cup (Live_{out}(B) \setminus def(B))$$

1. Basic Block B4:
• $use(B4) = \{d, e\}$, $def(B4) = \{g\}$
• Since B4 is followed by EXIT, $Live_{out}(B4) = \emptyset$.
• $Live_{in}(B4) = \{d, e\}$.

2. Basic Block B2:
• $use(B2) = \{a, e\}$, $def(B2) = \{d\}$
• $Live_{out}(B2) = Live_{in}(B4) = \{d, e\}$.
• $Live_{in}(B2) = \{a, e\} \cup (\{d, e\} \setminus \{d\}) = \{a, e\}$.

3. Basic Block B1:
• $use(B1) = \{b, c\}$, $def(B1) = \{a\}$
• Successors of B1 are B2 and B3.
• $Live_{out}(B1) = Live_{in}(B2) \cup Live_{in}(B3)$.

4. Basic Block B3:
• $use(B3) = \{a, f\}$, $def(B3) = \{e\}$
• Successor of B3 is B1 (loop back).
• $Live_{out}(B3) = Live_{in}(B1)$.
• $Live_{in}(B3) = \{a, f\} \cup (Live_{out}(B3) \setminus \{e\})$.

5. Solving Iteratively for B1 and B3:
• $Live_{in}(B1) = \{b, c\} \cup (Live_{out}(B1) \setminus \{a\}) = \{b, c, e, f\}$.
• $Live_{out}(B3) = Live_{in}(B1) = \{b, c, e, f\}$.
• $Live_{in}(B3) = \{a, f\} \cup (\{b, c, e, f\} \setminus \{e\}) = \{a, b, c, f\}$.
• $Live_{out}(B1) = Live_{in}(B2) \cup Live_{in}(B3) = \{a, e\} \cup \{a, b, c, f\} = \{a, b, c, e, f\}$.

Summary of Exit Live Variables ($Live_{out}$):
• B1: $\{a, b, c, e, f\}$
• B2: $\{d, e\}$
• B3: $\{b, c, e, f\}$
• B4: $\emptyset$

Therefore, Option (A) is correct.
